integrity: The analytic proof relies on the published sharp Kearns--Saul Bernoulli inequality; 29849 finite diagnostic assertions supplement rather than certify the global statements. Originality requires independent historical priority examination.
scientific_limitations: Exact known-variance one-dimensional Gaussian mixture with precisely two distinct observations and arbitrary positive normalized likelihood weights; probability law assumes independent Gamma weights. The supercritical atom locations remain implicit. No claims for more observations, approximate optima, heteroscedastic kernels or general fitted densities.
title: A sharp two-observation support transition for reweighted Gaussian-mixture likelihoods
